07 / INTRODUCING ENCLAVEAI

AI needs more than trust. It needs boundaries.

EnclaveAI is a runtime governance product under development that sits around AI interactions to evaluate policy, flag potentially unsafe behavior and capture enforcement decisions. A tiered inspection design separates quick checks from deeper analysis—so controls can be tailored to the risk and cost of each decision.
